title: pm-dispatch: a project seat creates its own hourly patrol routine, bound to its session
body:
Fixes #25991

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this changes

The pm-dispatch skill said a project seat's patrol routine runs every 2–4 hours and is created by the maintainer in the claude.ai Routines UI. The maintainer's word on the ui-lane project (2026-10-26, verbatim and untranslated):

> 你应该自己创建定时啊

> 为什么不是每小时

> 那需要立卡改 skills吗
> 立卡

Two points, the project-seat form only (Routine seats are untouched):

1. **Interval.** The project seat's patrol runs **hourly by default**; a lane may relax it with a reason, stated on its seat post.
2. **Who creates it.** The project seat creates its own patrol routine from inside its session, bound to that session (`create_trigger` in its default same-session mode — no `create_new_session_on_fire`, no `persistent_session_id`). The "maintainer creates it in the Routines UI" step is removed for project seats.

Kept, as the triage audit on the card fixes the boundary: the zero-output warning (now scoped to the new-session `create_trigger` form) and the `send_later`-chain ban.

Wording choices worth a reviewer's eye:

- `SKILL.md:71` drops the word 事件 from `PR 订阅事件` to land at exactly 120 bytes while keeping `每项目一个` — the one-per-project guard matters more now that seats create the routine themselves.
- The mechanism is spelled by contrast, not by parameter name: the project seat's routine is 自绑 (bound to its own session, the tool's default mode), and the warned-against form is the one that 开新会话 (opens a new session per fire). `platform-readings.md` already records both facts (an agent-created new-session Routine carries no GitHub tools; a self-bound trigger wakes an existing session with its tools loaded, at the cost of an orphan if that session dies — delete and recreate from the new session).
- The seat-post-protocol section keeps its smoke-test and rollback lines for both forms.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:项目席的巡查 routine 改为席位自己在会话内创建、绑定本会话(`create_trigger` 默认模式),默认每小时;车道有理由可放宽,间隔写在座位贴。「由维护者在 Routines UI 创建」只保留给 Routine 席;「开新会话的 `create_trigger` 拿不到 GitHub 工具、零产出」的警告保留并收窄到那一种形态;`send_later` 链禁令保留。四个文件各改一到四行,行数一行不增。

**为什么改**:你 2026-10-26 在 ui 车道项目的原话:「你应该自己创建定时啊」「为什么不是每小时」「立卡」。效果:新坐席的项目车道从第一分钟就有巡查,不用等你在 Routines UI 建一次;改判答复、半态巡查、补位这些非事件驱动的待命项最多晚一小时,不再是最多四小时。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:自绑触发器随会话生死——所绑会话一死,触发器成孤儿(平台读数已记:先删旧的、再从新会话重建,不留孤儿)。每小时唤醒比 2–4 小时多耗用量,车道可按理由放宽。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的一个 commit;各席已建的触发器由各席自己 `delete_trigger`。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:读完 diff 给一个字——批准则由你亲手落地(受管面 `.claude/**`,本 PR 保持 draft 等你),否决则关闭。

## Acceptance notes

Observed while measuring, outside the four named lines — noted here, not filed, for the seat to route:

- `references/project-forms.md:32` says the director and triage seats in one project may share one routine. A session-bound patrol trigger wakes only the session that created it, so a shared routine now wakes one seat thread; the other needs its own trigger or a poke. Not changed here (outside the card's four lines).
- `references/seat-post-protocol.md:61` (model pinned in the UI; a Routine inherits the environment default model) reads as Routine-seat text after line 58's split and is left as is; a self-bound trigger keeps the bound session's tier (`platform-readings.md`, the 自绑 facts). Not a contradiction of either point.
- `references/execution-duties.md:158` and `references/dispatch-runbook.md:122`, named in the dispatch as unverified candidates, were measured and contradict neither point: 158 says the project seat is woken by events and the patrol routine (consistent); 122 is the poke-trigger spelling (`create_trigger` with `persistent_session_id` plus `fire_trigger`) for message delivery, a different mechanism. `references/lanes/director.md:7` (direct-connect director seat: no Routine or cron) is about the director seat and out of scope.
- The card's evidence that a session-bound trigger runs with the seat session's own tools (the ui seat's hourly trigger) is a fleet colleague's statement. The wording here rests on `platform-readings.md` (self-bound triggers wake an existing session with its tools loaded) and the `create_trigger` tool contract (the default mode fires into the calling session), not on that trigger id.
